result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates against third-party IP claims, breach-of-law claims, HDI-caused data incidents, and gross negligence or willful misconduct; the Company’s reciprocal indemnity is limited to Company-provided Content/Marks and breach of law; and customary notice, defense control, settlement-consent, and cooperation procedures are included. The additions are targeted and do not alter unrelated commercial terms. Drafting quality is reduced by a structural numbering error: the provisions appear after the Section 10 heading as subsections (c)–(e), while the comment states they were placed in Section 9. That placement and any intended survival treatment should be corrected or clarified.
